conf.comment: ServiceNow change request (change_request) via System Export Sets CSV file. Direct route. state may be exported as either the numeric code or its label depending on the Export Definition's label setting; this ambiguity cannot be resolved generically, so the raw value is passed through unlookup'd to servicenow.change.state (see README gap). CSV has no value/display pairing, so assigned_to is the display full name.
